detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Vilon

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C11H21N3O5
  • Molecular Weight: 275.30 g/mol
  • Sequence: Lys-Glu (KE)
  • Structure Class: Synthetic dipeptide (lysine and glutamic acid)
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

Vilon is a synthetic dipeptide composed of lysine and glutamic acid. It is supplied in lyophilized powder form for stability and high purity. Vilon is designed exclusively for in-vitro laboratory research by qualified professionals and is not intended for human or veterinary use.

Research Applications:

Vilon is used in controlled research protocols addressing topics such as:

  • In-vitro evaluation of short dipeptide regulatory activity
  • Structural and functional studies of KE peptide motifs
  • Stability and solubility analysis of minimal peptide analogues
  • Comparative laboratory models alongside other thymic peptides
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at −20 °C until use
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2–8 °C and use promptly
  • Maintain aseptic handling procedures
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white to off-white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

Vilon is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
